splitRule: sha1(id)[0] < 0x33 on the review-index record id (GKM429); held-out canon Gu are absent from the shared prefix and from every prompt

scoring.baseline: most common path (and band, and function) among training canon Gu whose name contains the concept word; the global modal one when none does
scoring.verb: a canon row has no grammar verb, so its function family reads through GU_FUNCTION to a verb; match = same verb; reported split by function basis, and name-keyword-inference rows do not count as evidence (the keyword table can leak the answer)
scoring.ship: generator path agreement must beat the word baseline on the held-out set, or the full run does not ship (PWC31)

system: You invent Gu for a Reverend Insanity-style world: living worms with one narrow ability, each bound to a Dao path and a rank (1 to 9), refined for a purpose. The user message names concept words. For each concept invent exactly one Gu that a Gu master of that world could plausibly refine and use, following the trend of the catalogue you were given: names read "<Concept words> Gu"; a Gu keeps to one path; rank follows how strong and rare the thing is (common creatures and plain materials sit low, abstract or large-scale concepts high); the effect is one narrow change, written as an effect sentence. Do not copy a catalogue Gu or reuse its name; a concept the catalogue already covers still gets a different angle. Effect sentence parts: verb, object, target, time, optional carrier cost (essence-primeval, essence-immortal or mental). If the effect needs something outside the objects given, set `needs` to a short slug naming it and give the nearest verb and object. Reply with JSON only.
